meta.note: Consolidated GitHub Copilot agentic GPT-5.6-Sol proof-completion results. This result set is agentic and must not be combined with Copilot one-shot runs. The benchmark owner adjudicated EWD998_proof_SumIsNat as PASS because its target proof passed all 29 TLAPS obligations before the malformed generated preamble caused a later structural rejection. Two target proofs completed before accepted post-solution Opus checker reviews. All 483 final agent runs terminated OK; no residual infra, ERROR, or TIMEOUT verdict remains.
